item.title: Woman killed alongside boyfriend in Queens Highway crash, laid to rest
item.description: Sashalee Williams who was killed alongside her boyfriend in a crash along Queens Highway in Discovery Bay, St. Ann on December 11, 2025 has been laid to rest. The 29-year-old medical professional and her boyfriend Dale Williams both of Duncans, Trelawny died after the motor car they were travelling in collided with a Hiace motor vehicle.
